safeArea.decision: SafeArea.cs converts Screen.safeArea to canvas units each layout pass; the background stack (Nut, room, Stone, cracks, smoke) stays full-bleed and never moves; the DOM-layer groups anchored top (identity row, medals) shift by the top inset, the groups anchored bottom (events + QUIT, placeholder strip) by max(0, bottom inset - 22) (the 22 px the mockup already keeps under its homebar); sheets: CHOOSE YOUR DUEL (y 25.6-70.9 %) and the recess sheets need no inset; the deck builder's header and thumb band (92.7 %) shift like the menu's bands.
